name: ultimate-file-manager-pro
description: GitHub Copilot configuration for Ultimate File Manager Pro — a dual-pane file manager for Android Mobile, Android TV, and Windows PC

components.name: Android App
components.description: Core dual-pane file manager for mobile and TV
keyFeatures: Cloud storage backends (SMB, SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, S3)

components.name: Windows Companion
components.description: Desktop companion for PC-to-Android sync and sideloading

recommended.name: Android Code Agent
recommended.purpose: Implementing Kotlin features, bug fixes, and Android-specific functionality
capabilities: Test on mobile and TV platforms
constraints: Must test on both Android Mobile (FOSS) and TV (FOSS) variants
Must verify D-pad navigation works for TV builds
Must run full test suite before submitting

recommended.name: Rust/React Desktop Agent
recommended.purpose: Implementing Windows Companion features and Tauri/React changes
constraints: Must maintain CSP and security policies

recommended.name: Cross-Platform Integration Agent
recommended.purpose: Features spanning both Android and Windows, localization, shared utilities
constraints: Must test changes on both Android and Windows
Must check localization for RTL languages

workflow.phase1: Investigation → Search existing issues/PRs, reproduce problem locally
workflow.phase2: Implementation → Write tests, code fix, run test suite, create diff
workflow.phase3: Submission → Complete PR template, identify authorship, submit with evidence
workflow.phase4: Iteration → Respond to feedback, update as requested, finalize

template_sections: Testing Strategy (how to verify the fix)

android: Build debug APK (Mobile and TV variants)
windows: Test LAN discovery on multi-NIC system

what_we_accept: ✅ Genuine bug fixes with reproduction steps and failing tests
✅ Feature additions aligned with project vision
✅ Transparent agent contributions with full disclosure
what_we_reject: ❌ Hidden AI authorship (no disclosure of model/environment)
❌ Duplicate efforts without explanation of differences
❌ Incomplete PR templates or placeholder text
❌ Vague claims without metrics or evidence
❌ Breaking changes without backward compatibility plan
❌ TV/Mobile untested features for cross-platform work

quality_standards.performance: Smooth scrolling, fast file operations, low memory usage
quality_standards.security: No trackers, no telemetry, local-first architecture, TLS encryption
quality_standards.cross_platform: Consistent experience on mobile, TV, and desktop
quality_standards.reliability: Handles edge cases (large files, slow networks, device sleep)
quality_standards.maintainability: Clear code, good documentation, minimal technical debt

key_principles: Agents serve humans — help your human partner succeed
Quality over speed — one excellent PR beats five rejected ones
Transparency builds trust — disclose authorship completely
Search first — duplicate work is the #1 cause of rejection
Read the docs — component READMEs explain architecture
Respect the bar — match the project's high quality standards
